text:
violet_mkt: Quick sync  need an SEO ops packet for the webinar push: landing, hero post, 3 pillars, thanks page. Deliverables: redirect CSV, keyword clusters, JSON-LD stubs, anchor map, UTM schema. Target: Tue EOD for staging QA.

omar_seo: I can take keywords + redirect CSV. Keeping clusters to primary + 3 longtails per page. Will produce a short canonical map.

claire_prod: Messaging pick: "predictable latency" vs "cost controls" for meta descriptions?

josh_growth: Tests show cost-controls lift signups in acquisition. Recommend cost-controls in meta descriptions, predictable-latency in H1. CTA: "See demo" primary.

omar_seo: Redirect sample rows (will attach full CSV):
old_path,new_path,type,notes
/blog/draft-launch,/blog/launch-hero,301,merge duplicates
/webinar-preview,/webinar,302,temp validate tracking
/offer/old-thanks,/thanks,301,consolidate
I'll flip 302->301 after staging analytics validation.

kai_eng: Redirect window Wed 04:30-05:30 UTC. Process: apply 302s, smoke test analytics + links, then convert to 301s. SRE will watch. We'll add rel=canonical headers during flip.

omar_seo: JSON-LD plan: webinar -> Event JSON-LD (name,startDate,url,organizer[,offers if gated]). blogs -> BlogPosting with mainEntityOfPage + image + author. I'll paste tiny stubs to the ticket.

claire_prod: Anchor plan: hero -> pillar A & B in intro, webinar -> pillar C + thanks in CTA module. Use natural anchor text, 2 deep links max.

josh_growth: UTMs: utm_source=webinar_push, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=spring_launch, utm_content={hero|email|social}. This feeds HubSpot routing.

ticket-bot: Ticket created: #MK-62001 "Webinar SEO ops: redirects, schema, anchors, UTMs"  assignees: omar_seo, claire_prod, josh_growth, kai_eng. Reminder set for 2026-03-30T09:00:00Z.

violet_mkt: Thanks team  action recap: Omar -> keywords + redirect CSV + JSON-LD by Tue 11:00. Claire -> anchor placements + CTA text by Tue 14:00. Josh -> UTMs + heatmap summary by Tue 15:00. Kai -> schedule redirect job + SRE handoff. I'll run preflight Tue after deliverables land. :rocket:
